title: Anthropic reports elevated errors on claude.ai, console, and Claude Code, starting at 11:49 UTC and impacting logins, and says the API "is working as intended" (Mayank Parmar/BleepingComputer)
summary: Mayank Parmar / BleepingComputer: Anthropic reports elevated errors on claude.ai, console, and Claude Code, starting at 11:49 UTC and impacting logins, and says the API “is working as intended” — Claude appears to be having a major outage right now, with elevated errors reported across all platforms.
